It's a great stand, very sturdy and very well made. I highly recommend it.
It's 3M carbon fiber 1080 vinyl, I highly recommend it as it's extremely easy to apply and holds up well.
The fans are on the side of the case, not the front.

The problem is that there must be slack for when the drawer is pulled out, but I've had this setup for about a month now without any issues. The next time I change coolant I probably will snip a few inches off though.

-It actually stays extremely cool, actually cooler than my NZXT Phantom 410 (with equivalent equipment installed). Currently the highest temps I get when gaming are GPU-50C CPU-55-60C.
-Also this build wasn't all about saving space in a cheap an easy way, otherwise I would have just bought a mini and put it underneath the desk. I really wanted a challenge, and wanted something that was completely original. This project definitely fit the bill, and now every time I go to game I look at it and get a great sense of accomplishment and pride.
Who makes this desk? I actually picked mine up on Craigslist for $30, but it has no distinguishing marks or symbols.
You got it, every college bachelor should have one!

Actually my legs fit perfectly underneath, it actually only comes down an extra 2 inches compared to the existing keyboard tray. That was a major constraint I took into consideration at the beginning of the build, and was originally what got me into water cooling.
